task.title: P6-031: Add an Undo button to the teardown success toast
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-031. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**The teardown toast still has no Undo button, so on a phone a teardown is one-way through the UI.** `collection.rs:1702` builds the success toast with no `.action("Undo", …)` even though `receipt.move_ids` is in hand at `:1700` and already fed to `note_last_move` at `:1701` — so `⌘K → Undo last move` can reverse it, but the palette is desktop-only. Absorbs the old `P6-055g`: the confirm dialog's "every move is in the history" claim is now **true** (`hosted.rs:1245-1253` appends one move per board and `:1256` returns the ids), and this toast is the only remaining half.
